id: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Recycle.
en: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, Recycle.
it: \bDopo aver passato anni in questa città ho deciso di rendermi utile insegnando la mossa Riciclo.

id: \bI can teach it to you if you want?
en: \bI can teach it to you if you want?

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
en: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
it: \rMi dispiace molto, ma il termine per le iscrizioni è scaduto.

id: \bI lost to Dawn, but it's okay. I just need more practice.
en: \bI lost to Dawn, but it's okay. I just need more practice.
it: \bHo perso contro Lucinda, ma va bene così. Mi serve solo un po' più di pratica.

id: \bThanks. Dee Dee won't get the best of me next time.
en: \bThanks. Dee Dee won't get the best of me next time.
it: \bGrazie. La prossima volta Dee Dee non avrà la meglio su di me.

id: \bI can't believe I let Dawn win. Not next time.
en: \bI can't believe I let Dawn win. Not next time.
it: \bNon ci credo che ho lasciato vincere Lucinda. La prossima volta no.

id: \rNurse Joy: Congratulations on winning. I wish you luck.
en: \rNurse Joy: Congratulations on winning. I wish you luck.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Congratulazioni per la vittoria. Ti auguro buona fortuna.

id: \rDawn: Hi \PN. I just won my first Ribbon. Can you believe it?
en: \rDawn: Hi \PN. I just won my first Ribbon. Can you believe it?
it: \rLucinda: Ciao \PN. Ho appena vinto il mio primo Fiocco. Ci credi?

id: \rYou already got a badge too. Guess you won't let me stay ahead. After all, I barely won.
en: \rYou already got a badge too. Guess you won't let me stay ahead. After all, I barely won.
it: \rE tu hai già ottenuto una Medaglia. A quanto pare non mi lascerai stare in vantaggio. Del resto, ho vinto per un pelo.

id: \rI need some more battle experience if I want to keep winning. Care to help?
en: \rI need some more battle experience if I want to keep winning. Care to help?
it: \rMi serve più esperienza in lotta se voglio continuare a vincere. Mi dai una mano?

id: \rDawn: That was a big help. Thanks for the battle.
en: \rDawn: That was a big help. Thanks for the battle.
it: \rLucinda: Mi è stato di grande aiuto. Grazie per la lotta.

id: \rWell I'm off for the next contest. I'm sure I'll see you around.
en: \rWell I'm off for the next contest. I'm sure I'll see you around.
it: \rBene, io parto per la prossima gara. Sono sicura che ci rivedremo.
